description: This class includes the manufacture of coke and coke oven products by the destructive distillation of coal.
includes: manufacture of coke and semi-coke of coal
manufacture of pitch and pitch coke
manufacture of crude light oil from coal
manufacture of other coke oven by-products: benzol, toluol, xylol, naphtha, coal tar oils
excludes: manufacture of refined petroleum products, see 1920
